en.headline: Man arrested after parrot found with clipped wings and bloodstains in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 39-year-old owner was detained on suspicion of cruelty to animals after a resident reported an injured bird near Po Lam Road North on Monday evening.
body: Police arrested a 39-year-old man on suspicion of cruelty to animals after a parrot was found with its wing feathers clipped and showing bloodstains in Tseung Kwan O.

A resident reported the injured adult bird near 18 Po Lam Road North around 8:17 p.m. on Monday. Officers confirmed the man as the owner. The animal was later taken by staff of the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals for examination and care.
The suspect remains in custody pending further investigation. The case is being handled by Tseung Kwan O District’s Criminal Investigation Team 4.

zh.headline: 將軍澳鸚鵡疑遭剪翼流血 39歲男主人涉虐畜被捕
zh.dek: 市民周一晚在寶琳北路發現受傷成鳥，翅膀羽毛被剪並帶血漬，警方拘捕姓張男主人，案件交將軍澳警區跟進。
body: 警方昨晚在將軍澳拘捕一名39歲男子，涉嫌殘酷對待動物。事緣市民在寶琳北路18號對開發現一隻受傷成年鸚鵡，翅膀羽毛被剪短並帶有血漬。
報案時間約為晚上8時17分。警員到場後確認該男子為鸚鵡主人。愛護動物協會人員其後將雀鳥帶走檢查及照顧。
男子現正被扣留調查，案件交由將軍澳警區刑事調查隊第4隊跟進。
